events.speaker: PRISCA
events.text: Cobbett has three versions of it standing in type and every one has a monster in it. I have a press, four hours, and no facts whatever. Give me the plain account and I'll set it tonight.

events.speaker: PRISCA
events.text: Dull, correct, and going on the front page. Cobbett will outsell me four to one by Thursday. It will still be the true account, and it will still be true in ten years, when his is lining somebody's drawer.

events.speaker: PRISCA
events.text: A place, then, and first word whenever this camp does something worth a column. Understand that I will print it when it makes you look poor at the job, too.

events.speaker: PRISCA
events.text: You checked a thing before you told it to me. Have you any notion how seldom that happens? I have printed retractions over men who could not manage it once in a twelvemonth.
